title: Miller–Rabin Primality: Mental Model
idea: Write n-1 as d times a power of two and test whether modular powers witness compositeness.
complexity: Seven deterministic u64 bases; O(log n) modular multiplications per base using u128 products

sites.statement: let mut x = power(a % n, d, n);
x = (x as u128 * x as u128 % n as u128) as u64;
result = (result as u128 * a as u128 % n as u128) as u64;
a = (a as u128 * a as u128 % n as u128) as u64;
